name: Walking
notes: Compendium 17190: walking, 3.0 mph, level, moderate pace = MET 3.5. Chosen as the default casual-walk value. FLAG(nirmal): a leisurely 'sair'/'tehelna' may be closer to 17150 (2.5 mph, MET 3.0); pick one default for undifferentiated 'walk'.

name: Brisk Walking
notes: Compendium 17200: walking 3.5 mph, level, brisk = MET 4.3; 17220: 4.0 mph very brisk = MET 5.0. Used 5.0 for 'brisk/fast/power' to separate clearly from ex_walk. FLAG(nirmal): if you'd rather brisk be 4.3, change here.

name: Jogging
notes: Compendium 12020: jogging, general = MET 7.0. Ambulatory (jog collides with steps on same day).

name: Running
notes: Compendium 12050: running 6 mph (10 min/mile) = MET 9.8. Chosen as default recreational-run value. FLAG(nirmal): general 'run' with no pace could be treated slower (12030, 5 mph = MET 8.3); confirm default. Ambulatory.

name: Treadmill
notes: Treadmill has no single Compendium code; value depends on walk vs run and incline. Used MET 6.0 as a mid blend (between brisk walk 5.0 and jog 7.0). Marked ambulatory per spec/06 double-count rule (treadmill listed alongside walk/jog/run/hike). FLAG(nirmal): a single default hides walk-vs-run difference; decide whether to keep one blended value or split into treadmill_walk/treadmill_run.

name: Hiking
notes: Compendium 17080: hiking, cross country = MET 6.0. Ambulatory.

name: Cycling
notes: Compendium 01080: bicycling, 12-13.9 mph, moderate = MET 8.0; 01070 (10-11.9 mph, light) = MET 6.8. Used 7.5 as a general-effort midpoint. Not ambulatory (does not collide with steps). FLAG(nirmal): stationary 'spin/spinning' folded in here for simplicity though the Compendium separates it (02010-02015); split if you want spin classes valued differently. Unit minutes for effort logging; ex distance-based cycling ('10 km cycling') still parses as this id with unit km.

name: Swimming
notes: Compendium 18240: swimming laps, freestyle, light/moderate effort = MET 5.8; rounded to 6.0. General swim default. FLAG(nirmal): vigorous laps (18230) is MET 9.8 — confirm one default for undifferentiated 'swimming'.

name: Yoga
notes: Compendium 02150: yoga, Hatha = MET 2.5; general/flow practice trends higher. Used 3.0 as a general default. FLAG(nirmal): power/vinyasa yoga runs ~4.0; confirm whether 'yoga' should carry the gentle Hatha value 2.5 instead.

name: Surya Namaskar
notes: No dedicated Compendium code; sun salutations are a continuous, vigorous yoga flow, valued above Hatha. Used MET 4.0 (between yoga 3.0 and gym 5.0). FLAG(nirmal): some studies place brisk surya namaskar rounds near 5-6 MET; this is a judgment call and needs your confirmation. Users often log by rounds ('12 surya namaskar') not minutes — engine will need a rounds->minutes assumption, or treat qty as minutes; flag for spec decision.

name: Gym / Weight Training
notes: Compendium 02054: resistance/weight training, vigorous = MET 6.0; 02052 (light/moderate) = MET 3.5. Used 5.0 for a general 'gym'/'workout' session mixing effort levels. Not ambulatory. FLAG(nirmal): 'gym' is a catch-all — a treadmill-heavy gym visit is really cardio; consider whether bare 'gym' should default lower or prompt for detail.

name: Badminton
notes: Compendium 15030: badminton, social singles/doubles, general = MET 5.5. Not ambulatory.

name: Cricket
notes: Compendium 15040: cricket, batting/bowling = MET 4.8; rounded to 5.0. Not ambulatory (much standing between deliveries). FLAG(nirmal): casual gully cricket may be lower-effort than match play; single default used.

name: Football
notes: Compendium 15610: soccer, casual, general = MET 7.0 (15605 competitive = 10.0). Used casual default. Not ambulatory (does not stack with step count as a separate ambulatory exercise per spec/06 which lists only walk/jog/run/hike/treadmill). FLAG(nirmal): football involves heavy running and could arguably collide with step count; spec/06 defines ambulatory narrowly, so left false — confirm this is intended.

name: Skipping Rope
notes: Compendium 15551: rope skipping, moderate pace, general = MET 11.0. Not ambulatory (vertical, not step-tracked). FLAG(nirmal): slow skipping (15552) is MET 8.8; moderate default used.

name: Dancing
notes: Compendium 03031: dancing, general, moderate = MET 5.0. Not ambulatory. FLAG(nirmal): high-energy garba/bhangra runs closer to 7.8 (03015, aerobic high impact); a single general default is used — decide if regional dances deserve their own higher id.

name: Stairs Climbing
notes: Compendium 17133: stair climbing, general = MET 4.0 slow, but continuous fast stair climbing (17134) = MET 8.8. Used 8.0 for deliberate stair-climbing exercise. Left NOT ambulatory: spec/06 lists only walk/jog/run/hike/treadmill as ambulatory, and stair-machine climbing is not step-count double-counted. FLAG(nirmal): everyday stair use vs stair-machine workout differ a lot; confirm this id is only for intentional exercise logging.

name: Elliptical Trainer
notes: Compendium 02048: elliptical trainer, moderate effort = MET 5.0. Not ambulatory (spec/06 excludes it from the walk/jog/run/hike/treadmill set).

name: Zumba
notes: No dedicated Zumba code; mapped to Compendium 03019 (aerobic dance / step aerobics, general) ~ MET 6.5-7.3. Used 6.5. Not ambulatory. FLAG(nirmal): Zumba intensity varies by class; confirm default.

name: Pilates
notes: Compendium 02101: Pilates, general = MET 3.0 (some editions 3.8). Not ambulatory. FLAG(nirmal): reformer/advanced pilates trends higher; single general default used.
